name: esp32-s3-mini-1
watch_out_for: ESP32-S3 with native USB: flash directly over USB, no UART bridge needed. Smaller than ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (~15.4x20mm vs 18x25.5mm) but breaks out fewer GPIO, so a pin-hungry design (parallel-RGB panel, lots of I/O) may still need the WROOM-1. PCB-antenna keep-out is enforced via the autoplacer 'antenna_keepouts' config (footprint frame: long axis y, antenna at -y); that rect is geometry-derived, verify it against the ESP32-S3-MINI-1 datasheet keep-out for RF-critical or high-volume builds.
